en: Core sales rose 17% to $4.74B and EPS of $0.78 beat, both above Corning's own range; Optical Communications grew 32% to $2.07B, operating margin rose to 20.9% and free cash flow was $1.42B. Corning signed a multiyear, multibillion-dollar fiber deal with Amazon and a partnership with NVIDIA to expand US optical connectivity capacity tenfold. But the Q3 core sales guide of $4.9–5.0B came in below the ~$5.0B consensus. CEO Wendell Weeks reaffirmed the Springboard targets of a $20B sales run rate by the end of 2026.

The guide sank the stock, which fell as much as 18% intraday, on pace for its worst day since 2002, and closed 12% lower; it dragged down optical peers including Lumentum, Coherent and Marvell. Shares had already roughly halved from their late-June peak, so buyers returned fast: by Aug 4 the stock was 11% above the pre-report close and it peaked near $173 on Aug 17. It has since traded with the optical group and sits about 10% above its pre-report level.
zh: 核心销售额增长 17% 至 47.4 亿美元，每股收益 0.78 美元超预期，均高于公司自身指引；光通信业务增长 32% 至 20.7 亿美元，营业利润率升至 20.9%，自由现金流 14.2 亿美元。康宁与亚马逊签订多年期、价值数十亿美元的光纤协议，并与英伟达合作将美国光连接产能扩大十倍。但第三季核心销售指引 49–50 亿美元低于约 50 亿美元的预期。CEO 温德尔·威克斯重申 Springboard 计划：2026 年底实现 200 亿美元年化销售额。
指引令股价重挫，盘中一度下跌 18%，有望创 2002 年以来最差单日表现，最终收跌 12%，并拖累 Lumentum、Coherent、Marvell 等光通信股。股价此前已较 6 月下旬高点腰斩，买盘很快回流：8 月 4 日已较财报前收盘高 11%，8 月 17 日见顶约 173 美元。此后随光通信板块波动，目前较财报前高约 10%。

bio.en: Joined Corning in 1983 and has been CEO since 2005 and chairman since 2007. Championed Gorilla Glass for smartphones and now the optical-fiber build-out for AI data centers under the Springboard plan.
bio.zh: 1983 年加入康宁，2005 年起任 CEO，2007 年兼任董事长。曾力推智能手机用大猩猩玻璃，目前在 Springboard 计划下主导面向 AI 数据中心的光纤扩产。

bio.en: CFO since February 2022. Joined Corning in 2013 as CFO of the Optical Communications segment and was corporate controller from 2015, after more than 20 years in finance roles elsewhere.
bio.zh: 2022 年 2 月起任 CFO。2013 年加入康宁任光通信事业部 CFO，2015 年起任公司财务总监，此前在其他公司从事财务工作二十多年。
